description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R}.
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}, creating a token copy of Cormela.
 Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cormela dies, triggering itself and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Cormela's trigger, returning Heat Shimmer to hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
